E4C.embedding: lesson (when, do, avoid) + symptom, pinned E5, query prefix
E4C.status_rule: episode: resolved only when its transcript shows the fix verified (a verification quote), else unknown; lesson: resolved = every cited episode resolved; historical = no cited episode of the current era; active = an episode recurs after another cited one was resolved; unknown always allowed
E4C.threshold_source: E4c design: the largest threshold of a 0.40-1.00 sweep (step 0.05) on the E4b pool with max cluster <= 20 and >= 8 eligible clusters (rule declared before any cluster content was read; holds before and after the covered exclusion); approved by the coordinator
E4C.scope_rule: cross-project packet -> scope_target global (the >= 2 independence groups evidence rule applies); project-local packet -> scope_target project:<slug> of a cited episode's project (no 2-group rule; never the global store)

rules.split: stricter label of readers A and B (correct/grounded/useful need both true; harmful/overgeneralized count when either is true); reader C (split units only) is reported, never used for the bar
rules.grounded: the deterministic E4 check (every quote inside ONE evidence quote of the cited episode; group count, recurrence count and first/last seen recomputed by code from the cited episodes; the lesson's model eras recounted and its status allowed only with its evidence; its scope target matching the packet type; a cross-project lesson cites >= 2 independence groups) AND both readers' grounded label
rules.packet_types: cross-project and project-local units are pooled for the bars; each type is also reported per arm
rules.abstain: a packet answered with 'no lesson' gives no unit; abstentions are reported per run
rules.gemini_runs: pooled over both runs; each run also reported
rules.failed_output: a packet without a schema-valid output after the provider's retry counts as an arm failure, reported, no units
rules.no_units: an arm with 0 gradeable units cannot be GO
rules.verdict: GO-Gemini when Gemini passes every bar and Opus is at most opus_margin_max better on each margin metric; GO-Opus-only (owner call) when only Opus passes the absolute bars; else NO-GO
rules.already_covered: an eligible cluster whose members all belong to one E4 packet whose lesson was imported is excluded (reported as already in memory)
rules.scope_target: a cross-project lesson targets the global lesson store; a project-local lesson targets that project only
